title: Same-frame ESC + popover/QoS click: UI press hook runs at mapping time on the pre-cancel selection — demolish/lane commands the old code never produced
evidence: mouse.odin:119 `append(out, Intent(Cancel{}))` (phase-1 emit) — mouse.odin:185 `ui = inp.on_ui_press(inp.user, inp, left_press)` — input.odin:117-118 `mouse_map(inp, events, &inp.intents)` / `execute_all(inp, inp.intents[:])` — main.odin:759 `inp.demolish_node(&app.input, u32(app.input.sel_node))`. Old order (diff removed lines): `- } else if rl.IsKeyPressed(.ESCAPE) {` / `- app.sel_pipe = -1` / `- app.sel_node = -1` ran BEFORE `- if app.placing < 0 && popover_click(app, {f32(mx), f32(my)}) {`
detail: The phase-1 Cancel intent only executes in execute_all AFTER mouse_map returns, but on_ui_press (popover_click/qos_panel_click) is called synchronously inside mouse_map and sees sel_node/sel_pipe still set. Old handle_input deselected on ESC first, so the same-frame click fell through (no demolish, no lane edit). New code demolishes the selected entity or cycles a QoS lane — commands enter the action log that the pre-change code never produced (and the reverse sub-case: old fell through to a drag start, new swallows).
recommended_fix: Gate the on_ui_press call on the frame's pending cancel (skip it when esc_cancelled, mirroring placing_eff), or execute phase-1 intents before the press branch so the hook reads post-cancel state; pin ESC+popover-click and ESC+panel-click scenarios.

title: Same-frame ESC + left-release while placing: ghost drag.active diverts the release into the drag branch; Drag_Release click-selects without re-checking the Cancel-set swallow latch
evidence: mouse.odin:126-129 `placing_eff := inp.placing` / `if esc_cancelled {` / `placing_eff = -1` — mouse.odin:233-235 `} else if has_release || moves_n > 0 {` / `if inp.drag.active && placing_eff < 0 {` — exec.odin:94-95 `} else if inp.placing >= 0 {` / `inp.drag.active = true` (the placement ghost keeps drag.active true on every move frame) — exec.odin:105-114 `case Drag_Release:` / `commit_draw(inp)` / `moved := rl.Vector2Distance(mouse, inp.press) > 6` / `if !moved && !release_ui_hit(inp, mouse) {` / `click_select(inp, mouse)` (no press_swallowed re-check, unlike Select at exec.odin:134 `if !inp.press_swallowed && !moved && !release_ui_hit(inp, v.pos) {`). Old code (diff removed): `- app.drag.active = false` / `- app.press_swallowed = true` in the cancel block ran BEFORE the else-if chain, whose final branch was gated `- } else if rl.IsMouseButtonReleased(.LEFT) && !app.press_swallowed {`
detail: With placement armed, every move frame sets drag.active (ghost). On an ESC+release frame, placing_eff=-1 makes the mapping take the DRAG branch on the stale ghost state, emitting Drag_Release; the executor's Cancel sets press_swallowed but Drag_Release never re-checks it, so an unmoved release click-selects. Old code cleared drag.active in the cancel block and swallowed the release — nothing happened. Mouse-path parity delta introduced by the B2 placing_eff fix (r1 took the swallow-guarded Place_Release path here).
recommended_fix: Re-check press_swallowed in the Drag_Release executor before click_select (as Select does), or track the placement ghost separately from a draw drag (e.g. gate the drag branch on drag.placing < 0) so an ESC-cancelled placement release stays swallowed.

title: Chord path emits Press_Anchor AFTER Right_Click, undoing right_click_select's was_dragging swallow latch (old order: the latch won)
evidence: mouse.odin:165-170 `if has_left {` / `// the right+left chord re-anchored the latch above; a same-frame` / `// cancel (the placement Cancel just emitted) would re-latch it — emit` / `// the Press_Anchor so the press's reset wins (the old chord ran AFTER` / `append(out, Intent(Press_Anchor{}))` — this executes after the Right_Click intent. exec.odin:544-551 `right_click_select :: proc(inp: ^Input, pos: rl.Vector2) {` / `was_dragging := inp.drag.active` / `inp.drag.active = false` / `if was_dragging {` / `inp.press_swallowed = true // an interrupted drag's release must not re-select`. Old code (diff removed): the chord's `app.press_swallowed = false` ran BEFORE `- if was_dragging {` / `- app.press_swallowed = true // an interrupted drag's release must not re-select`, so the latch won.
detail: Executor order Cancel?→Right_Click→Press_Anchor leaves press_swallowed=false after a chord that interrupted a drag; the old final state was true, so a later unmoved left release click-selects where the old code swallowed it. Mouse-only unreachable (a mouse draw drag holds left, so no left-press edge can chord); needs a pad-Confirm/touch-started drag plus a mouse chord. r1 had no Press_Anchor here — the fix inverted the latch order the comment only designed against the Cancel latch.
recommended_fix: Emit Press_Anchor before Right_Click in the chord path (the old chord reset ran before the drag-interrupt latch), or make right_click_select's was_dragging latch sticky against a same-frame Press_Anchor.
